name: bugfree
description: Open-source, self-hosted error tracking for Next.js and Express: a lightweight Sentry alternative

scripts.build:sdk: npm run build -w @bugfree/core && npm run build -w @bugfree/browser -w @bugfree/node && npm run build -w @bugfree/express -w @bugfree/nextjs -w @bugfree/cli
scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build -w @bugfree/api -w @bugfree/web
scripts.demo:next: npm run build -w next-demo && npm run upload-sourcemaps -w next-demo && npm start -w next-demo
